description: Client-side script for managing Bill of Materials (BOM) form in ERPNext, including setup, validation, cost calculations, and related operations.

classes.name: BomController
classes.description: Controller class extending TransactionController for BOM-specific operations, including conversion rate, item code handling, and price list application.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes form queries and custom buttons for BOM form.

methods.name: onload_post_render
methods.description: Sets up multiple add feature for items grid.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Handles form refresh actions, button creation, and UI updates based on document state.

methods.name: make_work_order
methods.description: Creates a new work order from BOM.

methods.name: make_variant_bom
methods.description: Creates a variant BOM based on current BOM.

methods.name: setup_variant_prompt
methods.description: Displays a prompt dialog for selecting variant items and raw materials.

methods.name: make_quality_inspection
methods.description: Opens a mapped Quality Inspection document.

methods.name: update_cost
methods.description: Calls server method to update BOM costs.

methods.name: rm_cost_as_per
methods.description: Sets conversion rate to 1.0 if valuation or last purchase rate is selected.

methods.name: routing
methods.description: Fetches routing details and recalculates costs.

methods.name: conversion_rate
methods.description: Sets conversion rate based on company currency.

methods.name: item_code
methods.description: Handles item code change, resets BOM no, and fetches BOM material details.

methods.name: buying_price_list
methods.description: Applies price list to BOM items.

methods.name: conversion_factor
methods.description: Calculates stock quantity based on conversion factor and refreshes UI.
